OS-1.name: Reliability-Verified Air Purifiers (extended-life guarantee + real-time self-diagnostic)
OS-1.usage_context: Any household buying a purifier as a health/allergy necessity, not a discretionary gadget
OS-1.friction: Unit silently 'stops working' or 'dies' well before its expected life, with no warning and often outside a short return window - a complaint pattern visible across brands and across the full 2004-2023 span of this real corpus, meaning it has never been solved industry-wide
OS-1.enabling_trend: TC-R08 (Matter Air Quality Sensor cluster - the same connectivity layer could carry a self-diagnostic/runtime health signal); TC-R02 (ENERGY STAR IEF/CADR measurement already requires performance verification, a template for an ongoing performance-verified claim)
OS-1.evidence: src/real/taxonomy_real.py theme 'reliability', polarity-gated real-text classification, n=166 reviews

OS-2.name: Whisper-Quiet Night Mode
OS-2.enabling_trend: TC-R11 (Dyson formaldehyde-sensor press release, tangential); no real trend document in this corpus directly addresses acoustic engineering

OS-3.name: Smart/Connected Feature Expansion (app control, voice assistant)
OS-3.friction: Presumed friction with manual app/physical control
OS-3.enabling_trend: TC-R08 (Matter Air Quality Sensor device type), TC-R07 (Versuni's own AI-purifier launch)

verdict.recommended_name: Reliability-Verified Air Purifiers (extended-life guarantee + real-time self-diagnostic)
verdict.why: Real data presents a genuine Pareto trade-off, not a dominant winner: Whisper-Quiet Night Mode (OS-2) reaches more reviews (3.5% vs 1.58%) and touches higher-price-exposure products ($84,016 vs $26,358), but its satisfaction hit is the mildest of the two (-0.571 stars vs -2.223 stars). Reliability-Verified Air Purifiers (OS-1) was picked by the stated decision rule (src/real/decision_framework_real.py::pick_winner): among candidates with a real CSAT signal and non-trivial prevalence, the most SEVERE satisfaction hit wins over the broadest reach. That is an explicit, reversible judgment call, not a formula with only one answer - see 'most sensitive assumption' below.

killed.name: Whisper-Quiet Night Mode
killed.killing_metric: CSAT Impact = -0.571 stars vs the winner's -2.223 stars - the shallowest satisfaction hit of the two candidates with a real CSAT signal
killed.reason: Between the two frictions with a measurable satisfaction impact, Whisper-Quiet Night Mode loses on severity even though it may reach more reviews. A euro spent here buys less improvement in the metric that actually predicts whether a buyer stays a customer than the same euro spent on Reliability-Verified Air Purifiers.

killed.name: Smart/Connected Feature Expansion (app control, voice assistant)
killed.killing_metric: Friction Prevalence % = 1.016% (107 of 10529 reviews) - and on manual inspection, most of those mentions are FEATURE PRAISE, not complaints
killed.reason: Unlike the earlier synthetic-fixture version of this exercise, connectivity mentions are not literally zero in real data (~1%) - but they are the smallest of the three real candidates AND skew positive when they do appear (e.g., 'It is incredibly powerful and [connectivity feature]... impressed with it'). There is no real friction signal here to build a roadmap bet on, only a feature people occasionally mention liking.

verdict.sensitivity: The recommendation is most sensitive to the priority rule in pick_winner(): severity (most negative CSAT Impact) currently outranks reach (Friction Prevalence %) among candidates with a real CSAT signal. Swapping that comparator to prevalence-first would flip the winner to Whisper-Quiet Night Mode. This is a genuine, reversible judgment call - not resolved by the data alone, and not hidden behind a formula the code doesn't actually run.
verdict.first_experiment: Cross-reference the real review corpus's product-level failure mentions ('stopped working', 'died', 'never worked') against each real product's rating_number (a rough popularity proxy) to identify whether failure reports cluster in specific brands/price tiers or are evenly distributed - if evenly distributed, this is a category-wide manufacturing/QA opportunity; if clustered, it may instead argue for a narrower positioning bet against the worst-performing competitors specifically.
verdict.abandon_signal: If the failure-mention cross-reference above shows reliability complaints concentrated in 2-3 specific older/discontinued products rather than spread across the category, treat this as a solved-or-solving problem rather than a live opportunity, and abandon.
